verdict.rationale: Pilot's docs claim a built-in AI that gives "instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow" and runs scenarios, so you can "know if you can afford new hires." That covers the affordability question against its own books inside the portal. However, there is no evidence of a public API that an external agent could pull ledger data through, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented ledger/reporting API for agents, evidence that an external agent can query live ledger data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI answers feature.
